create_launch.description: Create a launch. The creator escrows for_sale_amount + locked_amount of the token in this call (creator authority required). FIXED mode needs a positive price; POOL mode a zero price. A launch below its soft cap at the end is canceled and refunded.

contribute.description: Buy into a live launch with KOIN (buyer authority required). FIXED mode: pulls exactly the cost of the tokens granted (partially filling the last buy); POOL mode: accepts KOIN up to the hard cap.

finalize.description: Settle a launch once its end time has passed (or a FIXED launch has sold out). Success: KOIN to the creator, unsold tokens returned or burned, payouts open. Below soft cap: all escrowed tokens back to the creator, refunds open. Callable by anyone.

process.description: Run one batch of payouts (DISTRIBUTING) or refunds (REFUNDING), at most `limit` buyers per call (default 20, max 30). Callable by anyone; call repeatedly until the launch reports COMPLETED or CANCELED.

claim_locked.description: Deliver a completed launch's locked tokens to its creator once the unlock time has passed. Callable by anyone; the tokens always go to the creator.

get_launches.description: List launches by ascending id: ids strictly greater than `start`, up to `limit` (default 50, max 100)

get_contribution.description: Get one account's contribution to a launch

get_buyers.description: List a launch's contributions in batch order: seq >= start, up to `limit` (default 50, max 100)
